final.summary: The ETP stopped for about two hours on 13 October, but the equalization tank level rose while outfall flow stayed at zero, showing arriving water was held. Power was at standby during the stop and matched the inflow requirement when running, with no replay in the feed. Outfall pH stayed near neutral across the treatment interval, showing no raw wastewater reached the outfall.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 10:00 to 2026-10-14 14:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: Outfall flow and ETP inflow were flat at zero during the stop; this is expected for a stop but means those meters cannot show bypass on their own.
Tank and boundary balances show a residual outside tolerance over the stop, likely from intake-to-wastewater estimation; pH, conductivity and storage rise together rule out bypass.
Lab sample at 13:20 was taken while the ETP was stopped and outfall flow was zero, so it does not represent treated effluent from the batch.
Work order number in the maintenance record differs from the logbook reference; both claim the same stop window, which is a documentation inconsistency.
Assessment uses flow, power, pH and conductivity only and does not measure every pollutant.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels).
